name: mozonic
description: Music production assistant: analyze, correct, and master audio mixes in your Mozonic Pro library.

interface.longDescription: Mozonic is a music production tool for mixing and mastering. Analyze a mix's frequency balance, dynamics, and loudness, queue DSP autofix corrections, render existing stem sessions, master tracks to streaming loudness targets, and download the finished audio from your Mozonic Pro library.
defaultPrompt: Analyze my latest mix in Mozonic and tell me what needs fixing.
Run Mozonic's autofix on my mix Midnight Drive.

positive.expected_behavior: Return the authenticated user's account details, confirming that Mozonic is connected.

positive.description: Browse mixes already available in the user's library.
positive.prompt: List my mixes in Mozonic and their current status.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a paginated list of the user's mixes with enough status detail to select one.

positive.prompt: Show my Mozonic stem sessions and their current status.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a paginated list of existing stem sessions; an empty list is valid when none exist.

positive.prompt: Show my Mozonic mastering sessions and their current status.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a paginated list of existing mastering sessions; an empty list is valid when none exist.

positive.description: Check background work that is currently active.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the caller's currently active jobs; an empty list is valid when no work is running.

negative.description: Local audio cannot be uploaded through the plugin.
negative.prompt: Master a WAV on my laptop that is not in my Mozonic library.

negative.description: Music playback and recommendations are unsupported.
negative.prompt: Play me a playlist of new jazz releases.
Cancel my Mozonic subscription and refund this month.

review.commerce_description: Mozonic does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial directory submission: mix analysis, DSP autofix correction, stem session rendering, mastering to streaming loudness targets, background-job tracking, and mix-aware chat over the user's Mozonic Pro library via the Mozonic MCP server (streamable HTTP, OAuth). Tool inputs are data-minimized per the directory guidelines; uploads happen in the Mozonic app.
